---
title: "Onsite Seminars on Open Science"
toc: false

The onsite seminars are seminars with 2–4 presentations organised in cooperation between the ITRN Steering Committee and the local node. The topic(s) covered are based on local needs and on the expertise available within ITRN.

## Past seminars
